verdict.rationale: Bolna documents multi-step outreach workflows with waits and retries, plus batch management through its CLI. None of the evidence shows a recurring schedule (cron-like or repeating triggers) for jobs or workflows. A one-off sequence with internal waits is not a recurring schedule, so it earns no credit here. missing for 10: a documented recurring or cron scheduling capability for workflows or batches, configuration of schedule intervals and timezones, and API/CLI controls for managing recurring schedules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
